description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우편부가서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2021년 우편 부가서비스에 대한 정보입니다. 이 데이터는 우정사업본부에서 제공하는 다양한 우편 부가서비스 정보를 담고 있으며, 각 서비스의 명칭과 이용 방법을 포함하고 있다. 주요 서비스로는 우편물 접수를 간소화할 수 있는 '간편사전접수플러스', 현금을 우편으로 안전하게 전달하는 '현금배달(통화등기)'... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우편 서비스명, 이용안내, 간편사전접수, 민원우편, 현금배달. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
